title: Image Reference
description: The record a published master image is consumed through (STORY-11, ADR 0005). It says which vSphere VM and snapshot the image is, which build made it, and which evidence shows how. Downstream Terraform and Citrix work reads this file; nothing downstream should find the image any other way. scripts/runner/image-reference.sh writes it and checks it. That script reads the top-level `required` list from this file and enforces the patterns below with its own rules; the rest of this file is the contract in words, for a reader.

schema_version.description: Bumped when this record changes shape

version.description: The image version: the UTC date of the build and the pipeline job id that ran it, for example 2026.10.08-4294. Unique per build, and it sorts by date. The VM and snapshot names carry it

vm.description: The master VM. It is powered off and is never started by a consumer

instance_uuid.description: The vCenter instance UUID. This, with the snapshot, is the image's identity: look the VM up by this value, not by name. It is not the BIOS UUID, which a clone inherits

name.description: The VM's name, which ends with the version

datacenter.description: The vSphere datacenter the VM is in

folder.description: The VM's inventory folder, as a path from the root

snapshot.description: The snapshot desktops are created from. Taken after the image was sealed and powered off, and only then

name.description: The snapshot's name, which ends with the version

id.description: The snapshot's vCenter managed object id. It is assigned by this vCenter and is only meaningful there

build.description: The pipeline run that produced the image, and where its evidence is kept

job_id.description: The job that holds the evidence as its artifacts

project.description: The GitLab project the job belongs to, as a path. A job id means nothing without it

job_url.description: The job's address. The evidence files named in this record are its artifacts, under evidence/. Artifacts expire, so this address can outlive what it points at

commit.description: The commit of this repository the image was built from

ref.description: The branch the image was published from. Publishing is refused from any branch but the default one unless it is explicitly allowed for a test, so anything else here marks a test image

timestamp.description: When the record was written, UTC

source.description: The installation media the image was built from

isos.description: One entry per ISO record the build used. Each passed the datastore check (ADR 0004, stage 2) in the same job, before the build started

filename.description: The ISO's file name. For the Windows ISO it states the edition, version and update level, which is how the source Windows version is recorded

sha256.description: The qualified SHA-256 from the record, which the datastore copy matched

stage2_evidence.description: The evidence file of the passing datastore check

seal.description: The seal that ran before the snapshot (ADR 0002)

evidence_index_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the build's final evidence index, index.json. It ties this record to the exact build evidence. It is NOT a hash of the image and is never called a checksum (ADR 0005): nothing hashes the VM's disks

evidence.description: Where the evidence is. This record is the one evidence file the index does not list, because it carries the index's hash

snapshot.description: The evidence file written when the snapshot was taken
